title: Surgical supply price check
description: Fetch cited public product pages and emit plausible USD unit prices.

items.title: Items to check
items.description: List of items to check. Each entry is either an item id string (hem_o_lok_cartridge, trocar, suture_set; a cited default URL is used) or an object {item, source_url (https), css_selector?, regex?, unitsPerPack?}. unitsPerPack must be set when the listed price is for a multi-unit pack.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Fetch and parse pages, but do not push dataset rows. Preview successful rows in OUTPUT.
